title: Pure Shaddoll
summary: Shaddoll cards with the Glorious Gallery support wave, Void Unleashing, Mathematician, and generic staples. Every Main Deck Shaddoll monster has both a Flip effect and a trigger effect when sent to the GY by a card effect, turning Fusion materials into searches, mills, and removal.

summary.title: Starters
points: Void Unleashing reveals a Shaddoll card in your hand to add two Shaddoll cards of different card types (Monster, Spell, or Trap) from the Deck, then discards a card by card effect—triggering that Shaddoll's GY effect immediately.

Lev Shaddoll Fusion sends an El Shaddoll Fusion Monster from the Extra Deck to the GY (such as El Shaddoll Apkallone to search), and Tributes a Fusion Monster to summon a Shaddoll Fusion of a different Attribute.
Shaddoll Fusion Fusion Summons an El Shaddoll using materials from your Deck if the opponent controls an Extra Deck monster.
Mathematician sends a Level 4 or lower monster (such as Shaddoll Squamata or Reeshaddoll Wendi) from the Deck to the GY on Normal Summon.

summary.title: Opening: Void Unleashing or Mathematician
steps: Activate Void Unleashing by revealing a Shaddoll in hand to search Lev Shaddoll Fusion and a Shaddoll monster, then discard Reeshaddoll Wendi or Shaddoll Squamata to trigger its GY effect.

Use Reeshaddoll Wendi to Special Summon Tohushaddoll Grysta or Shaddoll Hedgehog from the Deck, and activate Lev Shaddoll Fusion to send El Shaddoll Apkallone from the Extra Deck to the GY, searching Shaddoll Schism.
When Tohushaddoll Grysta is sent to the GY by card effect, use its GY effect to Fusion Summon El Shaddoll Meshahrail or El Shaddoll Construct, and Set Shaddoll Schism.

summary.title: GY Triggers & Tohushaddoll Grysta
summary.text: Because Shaddoll GY effects trigger whenever they are sent to the GY by a card effect, every Fusion Spell, Void Unleashing discard, and foolish mill generates advantage: Squamata sends any Shaddoll card to the GY, Wendi summons a Shaddoll from the Deck, Hedgehog searches a Shaddoll monster, Beast draws 1, Dragon destroys a Spell/Trap, and Ariel banishes up to 3 cards from either GY. Tohushaddoll Grysta can copy a Shaddoll Flip effect on Flip and performs a Shaddoll Fusion Summon by banishing materials from your field or GY when sent to the GY by card effect.

summary.title: Fusion Bosses & Control
points: El Shaddoll Meshahrail (Shaddoll + DARK + EARTH) is unaffected by the opponent's Spell/Trap effects and activated effects of lower-Level/Rank monsters, and pays 800 LP each turn to search any Shaddoll or Void Spell/Trap.
El Shaddoll Winda restricts both players to a single Special Summon per turn and cannot be destroyed by the opponent's card effects, summoned on the opponent's turn via Shaddoll Schism.

El Shaddoll Construct sends any Shaddoll card from the Deck to the GY on summon and destroys Special Summoned monsters at the start of the Damage Step, while Reeshaddoll Wendikurhu flips monsters face-down on either turn and Apkallone negates a face-up card permanently.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Shaddoll Schism banishes Fusion Materials from your field or GY during either Main Phase to Fusion Summon a Shaddoll Fusion Monster (such as Winda) and sends an opposing monster with the same Attribute to the GY without targeting.

El Shaddoll Fusion enables Quick-Play Fusion Summons during the Battle Phase or to dodge targeting, and Resh Shaddoll Incarnation revives a Shaddoll and flips monsters face-up or face-down from the GY.
